summary: Pinterest requires a mandatory manual review process for all applications before they can access the API. Developers must register their app, accept terms, and wait for email notification of approval, making the setup process dependent on external review timelines.

approval.notes: Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest and you will receive an email notification after your app has been reviewed.

steps.title: Verify account and accept terms
steps.detail: Verify your account's email address and go to My apps to accept the Developer Terms of Service.

steps.title: Register application
steps.detail: Provide app details to register your application for review.

steps.title: Configure redirect URI
steps.detail: On the Configure tab, scroll to the Redirect URIs section, enter your URI, and select Add to save.

nuances: Approval is required even for initial access.
Trial access is granted after successful review.
Product limited tokens can be used for testing once Trial access is approved.
